description:
Get download links for the picked photos of one hire, as zip files of up to 100 photos each. Links last 15 minutes.
Use for: downloading the photos you kept with pick_photos.
Not for: looking through the photos one by one (list_hire_photos).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: download_picked_photos({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc"})
Errors: no_picked_photos, no_submission, no_photo_submission, photos_not_available; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

name: download_picked_photos

expiresAt.description: When the links stop working. Ask again for new ones.

parts.description: One zip file per 100 photos, in order.

url.description: Download it with a plain GET and no key: the link itself is the permission.

pickedCount.description: Picked photos in the zip files.

title: Download the picked photos
